records.deidentified_narrative: upon arrival i met with (wit1) gallegos, anna, maria w/f at the dollar general at [roadway], who [roadway], not at the cross walk, at about the [roadway]. she said they had just left the food city, and were going home. they had crossed the [roadway], and were attempting to cross the west bound lanes. she said her husband vic1 alvarado, jesse w/[medical facility] by medstar amb# 47 prior to our arrival, was just ahead of her, when he was hit by a beige suv (sus veh gold chevrolet tahoe unknown temp tag) that went around another vehicle that stopped when they saw them. she said sus veh passed the other vehicle that stopped, on the right and drove on the shoulder. she said it looked as though sus veh sped up and hit her husband. she said sus veh did not stop and fled the scene of the accident. anna said her husband was hit by the front end of the sus veh, and she did not see the driver, and could not identify them. she said the driver and passenger of the other vehicle followed the sus veh, but could not get a license plate number. anna said she was told that the sus veh had just left the dollar general before it hit her husband, and she was there to see if there was security video that could help identify the driver. i then spoke with wit2 hammons, gerald, wayne w/m who said he saw the accident, and could identify the driver. he said the driver was a hispanic male with short faded black hair, and looked to be in his late 20’s early 30’s. he said they followed the other vehicle, but stopped following them after they were advised by dispatch to stop. officer o'donohue went inside to see if the dollar general had video of the driver or passenger of the sus vehicle. he said there was video from the inside that shows the passenger buying some wine from inside the store before the accident. officer said there is video of the outside of the store, but it was bad quality, and could not make out any identifiers for the vehicle. i contacted rtcc officer l. carrell id# 2840 and they were able to get video of the intersection of e long and decatur. the video shows the sus veh just before the accident. officer l. carrell was able to save the video, and upload it to evidence. com under this report number. he said there was no video of the accident. i then left to jps to speak with jesse and see what his condition was. i spoke with tiu sgt and advised him of this call. vic1 jesse said he could not identify the driver, and he said he was in pain. jesse said he saw the vehicle coming, and he tried to speed up to get across, but was unable too. he said he was having trouble breathing and i could see he had cuts on his right knee and right elbow. i was able to take pictures of his visible injuries, and spoke to the doctor about his condition. the doctor said he had fractured some ribs, but was in stable condition. she said they were going to keep him over night, but he was going to be fine.

records.public_safe_text: upon arrival i met with (wit1) gallegos, anna, maria w/f at the dollar general at [roadway], who [roadway], not at the cross walk, at about the [roadway]. she said they had just left the food city, and were going home. they had crossed the [roadway], and were attempting to cross the west bound lanes. she said her husband vic1 alvarado, jesse w/[medical facility] by medstar amb# 47 prior to our arrival, was just ahead of her, when he was hit by a beige suv (sus veh gold chevrolet tahoe unknown temp tag) that went around another vehicle that stopped when they saw them. she said sus veh passed the other vehicle that stopped, on the right and drove on the shoulder. she said it looked as though sus veh sped up and hit her husband. she said sus veh did not stop and fled the scene of the accident. anna said her husband was hit by the front end of the sus veh, and she did not see the driver, and could not identify them. she said the driver and passenger of the other vehicle followed the sus veh, but could not get a license plate number. anna said she was told that the sus veh had just left the dollar general before it hit her husband, and she was there to see if there was security video that could help identify the driver. i then spoke with wit2 hammons, gerald, wayne w/m who said he saw the accident, and could identify the driver. he said the driver was a hispanic male with short faded black hair, and looked to be in his late 20’s early 30’s. he said they followed the other vehicle, but stopped following them after they were advised by dispatch to stop. officer o'donohue went inside to see if the dollar general had video of the driver or passenger of the sus vehicle. he said there was video from the inside that shows the passenger buying some wine from inside the store before the accident. officer said there is video of the outside of the store, but it was bad quality, and could not make out any identifiers for the vehicle. i contacted rtcc officer l. carrell id# 2840 and they were able to get video of the intersection of e long and decatur. the video shows the sus veh just before the accident. officer l. carrell was able to save the video, and upload it to evidence. com under this report number. he said there was no video of the accident. i then left to jps to speak with jesse and see what his condition was. i spoke with tiu sgt and advised him of this call. vic1 jesse said he could not identify the driver, and he said he was in pain. jesse said he saw the vehicle coming, and he tried to speed up to get across, but was unable too. he said he was having trouble breathing and i could see he had cuts on his right knee and right elbow. i was able to take pictures of his visible injuries, and spoke to the doctor about his condition. the doctor said he had fractured some ribs, but was in stable condition. she said they were going to keep him over night, but he was going to be fine.

records.public_safe_text: unit 1 was traveling northbound in the #2 lane on the [roadway]. unit 1 is a freightliner truck tractor towing a flat bed trailer (unit 2). a pedestrian, unit 3, was walking north on the dallas north tollway in the #4 lane. as unit 1, towing unit 2, approached the pedestrian, the pedestrian walked into the #3 lane. unit 1, towing unit 2, began to slow and veer to the left to avoid the pedestrian which was walking into the #2 lane. the pedestrian continued walking into the #2 lane as unit 1 passed the pedestrian. the pedestrian walked into the right side of unit 2 and became lodged under the right rear tire on the front tandem axle of unit 2. the pedestrian was dragged along the roadway for 36. 6 feet before units 1 and 2 came to a stop. the pedestrian [medical facility] where she was pronounced dead at 2:57 pm. a witness observed the pedestrian drinking a ""4 loco"" alcoholic beverage at 11:26 am earlier that day. it was also discovered that the dallas police department had transported the pedestrian to mental hospitals for confinement 4 separate times since february 5th 2020. the most recent mental confinement was on july 5th 2020 and the dallas officer stated that the pedestrian was running around [roadway] in a delirious state on that occasion. it appears that mental illness may be a contributing factor to this crash. the collin county medical examiner collected samples to analyze for a toxicology report. i received this report on november 9th, 2020. the pedestrian showed to have a blood alcohol content of 0. 224 g/100dl and 1. 4 ng/ml of delta-9 thc.
